description: 50% of the global workforce completed training as part of employer learning and development initiatives in 2025, up from 41% in 2023.

instances.assertion: 50% of the global workforce completed training as part of employer learning and development initiatives in 2025, up from 41% in 2023.
Training completion rates for the workforce have increased from 41% in 2023 to 50% in 2025 globally.
